name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
December 8, 2009
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 600 Eucalyptus Avenue, Vista, CA
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Celia Taghdiri, Member of the Baha’i Faith
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Proclamation declaring December 9, 2009, "Keeley Garcia Day" in the City of Vista in recognition of her life saving efforts. (CC)
P2.
Proclamation declaring December 10, 2009, "Deidre Smith Day" in the City of Vista in recognition of her life saving efforts. (CC)
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD)
C3.
Treasurer's Cash Report for Month Ending October 31, 2009 (CC)
C4.
Special Event Banner Program - 2009 Calendar Year (CC)
C5.
Authorization to Destroy Records (CC)
C6.
2010 Scheduled Commission, Committee, and Board Vacancies (CC)
C7.
State Energy Program Grant (CC)
C8.
Del Mar Fairgrounds Seasonal Train Platform (CC)
C9.
City Council Policy Updates (CC)
C10.
Cities Readiness Initiative Program Grant (CC)
C11.
Fiscal Year 2008 Assistance to Firefighters-Fire Prevention Grant (CC)
C12.
2009-2010 Motorist Aid and Safety Grant Award (CC)
C13.
Supplemental Law Enforcement Services Fund (CC)
1.
Approve the expenditure plan for the fiscal year 2009-2010 Supplemental Law Enforcement Services Fund grant; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2009- , amending the Operating Program Budget for the 2009-2010 fiscal year.
C14.
Community Development Commission 2008-2009 Annual Report (CC/CDC)
1.
Adopt Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2009- , approving the 2008-2009 Annual Report; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2009- , accepting the 2008-2009 Annual Report of the Community Development Commission of the City of Vista.
C15.
West Vista Way Sewer Rehabilitation Project Amendment (CC)
C16.
Grapevine Road Phase II Street Improvement Project (CIP No. 8018) (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2009- , denying the bid protest by Dick Miller, Inc., and awarding a construction agreement to Western Dirt for construction of the Grapevine Phase II Street Improvement Project (CIP No. 8018); and (recommended action continued on following page)
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2009- , approving a construction agreement with Vista Irrigation District for construction of water improvements for the Grapevine Phase II Street Improvement Project (CIP No. 8018).
C17.
City Facilities Interconnect Project (CC)
C18.
Sports Park Way Easement Purchase (CC)
DISCUSSION
D1.
Public Arts Commission - "Kites Over Vista" Approval (CC)
D2.
Vehicles for Sale on Public Streets (CC)
1.
Introduce and Adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2009- , entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Title 10, Chapter 10.32, Section 10.32.060 of the Vista Municipal Code Relating to Authority to Remove Vehicles for Sale on Public Streets"; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2009- , approving City Council Policy 600-11, "Procedure and Criteria for Prohibiting Vehicles for Sale."
D3.
Fiscal Year 2009/10 First Quarter Financial Report (CC/CDC)
1.
Receive the report and adopt the following:
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2009- , amending the Operating Program and Capital Improvement Program Budgets for the 2009/10 fiscal year;
3.
Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2009- , amending the Operating Program Budget for the 2009/10 fiscal year; and
4.
City Council Resolution No. 2009- , amending the Citywide Classification and Compensation Index.
D4.
Selection of Mayor Pro Tempore (CC)
PUBLIC HEARING
PH1.
Adoption of Standards for Public Works Construction (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to receive testimony, close the public hearing, and;
2.
Adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2009-22, entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Chapter 16.04 of the Vista Development Code by Adopting the 2009 Edition of the Standard Specifications for Public Works Construction, and the 2009 Edition of the San Diego Area Regional Standard Drawings including Indices and Appendices by Reference with Additions and Amendments.
PH2.
Acquisition Disposition and Development Agreement with North County Ford, and Adoption of a Resolution of Necessity Concerning the Riviera Motel (CC/CDC)
1.
Conduct a joint public hearing to receive testimony regarding a Negative Declaration for the North County Ford Automotive Dealership Project; a Resolution of Necessity for 242 Vista Village Drive; and an Acquisition and Disposition and Development Agreement with Care/West Vista Way LLC, and Vista Properties, LLC; close the public hearing; and take the following actions:
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2009- , and Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2009- , adopting a Negative Declaration for the North County Ford Automotive Dealership Project; (recommended action continued on following page)
(recommended action continued from previous page)
3.
Adopt Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2009- , approving the Resolution of Necessity;
4.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2009- , and Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2009- , approving the Summary Report and an Acquisition Disposition and Development Agreement with Care/West Vista Way, LLC, and Vista Properties, LLC; and
5.
Authorize the City Manager/Executive Director to execute the escrow instructions, deeds, and other documents and actions required to close escrow and implement the project on behalf of the City and the Commission.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
